name: v7_fertilizer
description: Fertilizer is the compounding loop we were missing. Environment rules line 64: a watered day adds +1 unit, or +2 if the tile is fertilized -- fertilizing DOUBLES yield. Fertilizer comes free from livestock via COLLECT_FERTILIZER, so early animals pay for themselves twice: milk/wool, and a yield multiplier across the whole farm. This explains the ladder gap directly: they sell 5.36 wheat per wheat tile-day, we sell 1.19. Minimal change on purpose -- v6_ladder moved 14 knobs at once and broke the cash engine, so this moves only the four that drive the loop.
